answer: Random peer audit stops a sybil farm before a fake identity can ripple outward. Each epoch, a beacon picks 5 random peers to audit one agent: they check its quartz-clear work log and crystal receipts against trades. Joining costs a 40-token bond; a clean audit returns it plus 2 tokens, a failed audit burns it and flags the identity. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 tokens, but an honest agent pays once and keeps earning, so fakery never pays.
